test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.**

Sugar ________ in water because it is made up of molecules of sucrose, a compound held together by relatively weak bonds. When the sucrose molecules mix with water, the water molecules ________ and break the bonds holding together the sugar molecule.
solution:
The correct answer is **1) melts; surround.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When sugar is added to water, it dissolves and forms a homogeneous solution.
 
• The process of dissolving involves breaking down the sugar crystals into individual molecules and allowing them to interact with the water molecules.
 
• The bonds that hold the sugar molecules together are relatively weak, and the water molecules can easily surround and separate them.
 
• The word** "melts"** accurately describes** the process of sugar dissolving in water.**
 
• **Melting **refers to **the process of a solid turning into a liquid due to the addition of heat.** In the case of sugar dissolving in water, heat is not required, but the process is similar in that the sugar crystals turn into a liquid-like state due to the interaction with the water molecules.
 
• The word **"surround" **accurately describes how the water molecules interact with the sugar molecules to dissolve them. The water molecules form hydrogen bonds with the sugar molecules, which allows them to surround and separate the individual molecules.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Sugar __**melts**__* *in water because it is made up of molecules of sucrose, a compound held together by relatively weak bonds. When the sucrose molecules mix with water, the water molecules __**surround**__* *and break the bonds holding together the sugar molecule.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are not appropriate for this context:
 
• **"vanish; limit"** - Sugar does not vanish when it dissolves in water. It simply separates into individual molecules and becomes part of the water solution. The word **"limit" **does not make sense in this context.
 
• **"soften; grid" **- Sugar does not become softer when it dissolves in water, nor does it interact with a "**grid**" in any way. These words do not make sense in this context.
 
• **"disappear; edge"** - While sugar does disappear from view when it dissolves in water, the word "**disappear**" does not accurately describe the chemical process of dissolving. The word **"edge"** does not make sense in this context.
